generation.scope: On reduced four-edge finite Frobenius windows, all integral eight-cofactor opposite matrices are excluded, including both singular boundary Hankel members and the finite nodal order-two member. For arbitrary finite windows the boundary normal forms have length at most sixteen off the conductor input line.

open_mathematics: Analyze conductor-supported nilpotents in the singular boundary normal forms, and test the singular finite pencils on nonreduced windows. Higher-cofactor, reducible determinants and general-window coverage remain open.
